# BUKKBEEK — Jude Udumullage, 3D game artist & Godot developer

> Freelance 3D generalist, VFX artist and Godot developer based in Ontario, Canada
> (originally Sri Lanka). Creator of the Godot asset packs **EffectBlocks** and
> **NatureBlocks**, plus **Ceylon Blocks** and the open-source **Godot Pixel
> Renderer**. Portfolio: stylized, low-poly, game-ready 3D assets, environments
> and visual effects. Available for commissions.

- Email: bukkbeek3d@gmail.com
- Site: https://bukkbeek.github.io/
- Detailed plain-text summary: https://bukkbeek.github.io/llms-full.txt

## Godot asset packs

- [EffectBlocks](https://bukkbeek.itch.io/effectblocks): 100+ customizable low-poly stylized 3D VFX effects for Godot — fire, smoke, explosions, magic, energy, decals, space.
- [NatureBlocks](https://bukkbeek.itch.io/natureblocks): 500+ stylized nature assets for Godot with procedural terrain generation, vegetation scatter tools, materials, shaders and environment presets.
- [Ceylon Blocks](https://bukkbeek.itch.io/): free Sri Lankan heritage-inspired low-poly 3D asset collection (cultural architecture, tropical environments).

## Developer tools

- [Godot Pixel Renderer](https://github.com/bukkbeek/GodotPixelRenderer): open-source 3D-to-pixel-art renderer for Godot 4 with frame-by-frame animation export. Featured by Games From Scratch.
- [Godot FPS Template](https://bukkbeek.itch.io/godot-fps-template): modular FPS starter — movement, weapons, enemy AI, interactables, vehicles.
- [Godot Terrain Generator](https://bukkbeek.itch.io/godot-terrain-gen): GridMap terrain with tiles, buildings, road networks and procedural forests.
- [wikiBlocks](https://github.com/bukkbeek/wikiblocks): file-based markdown wiki for personal knowledge bases.

## Games & commissioned work

- [REBEL.101 / Tanks Gone Rogue](https://bukkbeek.itch.io/tanks-gone-rogue): solo-developed dystopian tank combat game — design, programming, 3D art, UI, VFX.
- [Lancer Tactics](https://wick.itch.io/lancer-tactics): VFX artist — explosions, weapon effects, shields, line effects for the Lancer TTRPG adaptation.
- Warminer: lead 3D artist on a sci-fi RTS (Unity).
- EION: dystopian 3D side-scrolling adventure with base building (Godot).
- Universe Island: game planner and lead 3D designer; flat-shaded low-poly art and trailer.
- Nomad's Barge: fantasy airship featured in *Bone and Arrow* by Skew Back Studios.
- Environments: Lakeview Bakery, Forest Ruins, Moon City, Car Factory, Creepy Creams, Space Lab, Underwater VFX.

## Services

- Custom 3D game assets (characters, environments, props, vehicles)
- Stylized low-poly modelling for mobile, indie and VR
- Environment art and scene composition
- VFX, particle and shader work for Godot and Unity
- Blender-to-Unity / Blender-to-Godot asset integration and optimization
